summary: Shows adding distribution servers with URLs and tokens in the [galaxy] server_list and [galaxy_server.NAME] sections of ansible.cfg, and notes --api-key can't be used for servers defined there.
questions: How do I add another Galaxy server and its token to ansible.cfg?
Why is --api-key ignored for my configured server?
What is the default distribution server?

answer_card.title: Configure Galaxy servers in ansible.cfg
answer_card.answer_md:
Galaxy is the only server by default. Add servers in `ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[galaxy]
server_list = release_galaxy

[galaxy_server.release_galaxy]
url=https://galaxy.ansible.com/
token=abcdefghijklmnopqrtuvwxyz
```
`--api-key` can't be used with servers defined in the server list.
